title: Trophic interactions in Caribbean coral reefs
loadability_evidence: No native EwE model file was verified or loaded; paper availability does not establish complete reconstruction.
documentation_evidence: ICLARM Technical Report 43 provides five Ecopath II model versions, parameter derivation and diets. Section 2.3 defines a composite PRVI reef transect; British Virgin shelf is included geographically.
notes: EcoBase 324 lists 21 groups for one version; no single group count is assigned to the five-model report.
quality_rationale: Provisional screening score. A readable source is not evidence of a successfully reconstructed or load-tested Ecopath model. No native EwE model file was verified or loaded; paper availability does not establish complete reconstruction.
geometry_method: No defensible digital study boundary located
recommendation: Puerto Rico/Virgin Islands coral reef systems; not complete Caribbean basin.
coverage_note: Puerto Rico/Virgin Islands coral reef systems; not complete Caribbean basin.
